mototaxi.name: MotoTaxi
mototaxi.tagline: Fast and safe transport in the city
mototaxi.shortDescription: Fast motorbike transport to any destination in the city.
description: MotoTaxi offers fast motorbike transport for people who want to avoid traffic and reach their destination without delay. Whether you're heading to work, university, a meeting, the airport, or anywhere else, we guarantee a safe, comfortable, and professional ride.
Our mission is to save you time and give you a modern, reliable transport experience.

features.title: Any destination
features.desc: Work, university, meetings, or the airport — anywhere in the city.

features.title: Professional rides
features.desc: Trained, courteous operators who are always on time.

mototaxi-premium.name: MotoTaxi Premium
mototaxi-premium.tagline: The ideal solution when time is a priority
mototaxi-premium.shortDescription: You travel by motorbike, your car follows — both arrive on time.
description: MotoTaxi Premium is a unique service created for people stuck in traffic with their own vehicle who need to reach their destination as quickly as possible.

The service is carried out with maximum professionalism and strict safety procedures. For full transparency, at the client's request, the vehicle can be temporarily fitted with a camera during transport.
MotoTaxi Premium is the ideal choice for important meetings, flights, urgent commitments, or any situation where every minute counts.

process.title: First operator
process.desc: Takes you immediately by motorbike to your destination.

process.title: Second operator
process.desc: Takes charge of your vehicle and delivers it wherever you choose — home, workplace, airport, hotel, or any other address.

mototaxi-premium.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'm interested in the MotoTaxi Premium service (ride + vehicle delivery). Please contact me.

motodelivery.name: MotoDelivery
motodelivery.tagline: Fast deliveries for individuals and businesses
motodelivery.shortDescription: Fast deliveries for individuals and businesses, every day.
description: MotoDelivery offers fast and safe transport for documents, packages, products, and orders across the city.
The service suits both individuals and businesses — restaurants, pharmacies, online shops, offices, and companies that need reliable deliveries.

features.title: Single deliveries
features.desc: For individuals and one-off needs, anywhere in the city.

features.title: Monthly business contracts
features.desc: A stable logistics partnership for businesses with ongoing needs.

motodelivery.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'd like to arrange a MotoDelivery. Please contact me with more details.

motoguide.name: MotoGuide
motoguide.shortDescription: Explore the city with a local motorbike guide.
description: MotoGuide is a dedicated service for tourists and visitors who want to discover the city in a fast, practical, and unique way.
Your MotoTaxi guide accompanies you throughout the itinerary, helping you visit the main sights and most interesting spots while saving time and avoiding traffic.
motoguide.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'm interested in a MotoGuide tour. Please send me more information.

airport-transfer.name: Airport Transfer
airport-transfer.tagline: Reliable transport and services to and from the airport
airport-transfer.shortDescription: Safe transport to and from Tirana International Airport.
description: MotoTaxi offers fast and safe transport to and from Tirana International Airport, helping you avoid traffic and arrive on time for your flight or destination.

Besides passenger transport, we also offer authorized airport services: if you can't be there in person, our team can pick up or deliver documents, keys, small luggage, or other authorized items on your behalf, with professionalism, discretion, and complete reliability.
Our goal is to save you time and give you a safe, flexible, and trustworthy solution for anything airport-related.

features.title: Passenger transfer
features.desc: Direct rides to and from Tirana International Airport.

features.title: Authorized services
features.desc: Pickup/delivery of documents, keys, and luggage on your behalf.

airport-transfer.whatsappMessage: Hello! I need an Airport Transfer. Please contact me with more details.
